people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Kidron
people.line: A valley east of Jerusalem, site of significant events

translations.web: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.
translations.bsb: They proceeded to remove the altars in Jerusalem and to take away the incense altars and throw them into the Kidron Valley.
translations.kjv: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
translations.asv: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
